evidence.title: PVC pipes still litter North Carolina river 2 years after Hurricane Helene

occurrences.checkable_against: MountainTrue cleanup and disposal records for IPEX PVC pipe
occurrences.quote_span: MountainTrue estimates its crews have pulled hundreds of thousands of pipes from the river — most of which went to landfills — with an untold number still littering the river for 70 miles (113 kilometers) to a large lake at the Tennessee border.
occurrences.speaker: MountainTrue
occurrences.subject: MountainTrue cleanup of IPEX PVC pipe in the French Broad River

occurrences.checkable_against: MountainTrue river survey and cleanup records for the French Broad River
occurrences.quote_span: MountainTrue estimates its crews have pulled hundreds of thousands of pipes from the river — most of which went to landfills — with an untold number still littering the river for 70 miles (113 kilometers) to a large lake at the Tennessee border.
occurrences.speaker: MountainTrue
occurrences.subject: MountainTrue cleanup of IPEX PVC pipe in the French Broad River

occurrences.checkable_against: North Carolina state grant award and extension records
occurrences.quote_span: A $10 million state grant awarded to MountainTrue in 2025 to clean up debris in several western North Carolina rivers that was set to expire in December has been extended to February.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: MountainTrue cleanup of IPEX PVC pipe in the French Broad River

occurrences.checkable_against: MountainTrue disposal and reuse records
occurrences.quote_span: Almost all of the pipes go to a landfill, though some in good condition are given to community members because there are no good recycling options, MountainTrue said.
occurrences.speaker: MountainTrue
occurrences.subject: MountainTrue cleanup of IPEX PVC pipe in the French Broad River

occurrences.checkable_against: MountainTrue debris composition assessments
occurrences.quote_span: PVC pipe comprises 80% of the debris in some areas, according to MountainTrue, posing risks to rafters and kayakers, changing water flow and altering the ecosystem.
occurrences.speaker: MountainTrue
occurrences.subject: MountainTrue cleanup of IPEX PVC pipe in the French Broad River

occurrences.checkable_against: MountainTrue staffing records
occurrences.quote_span: Stamper, who formerly worked for a whitewater river outfitter and now oversees 10 cleanup crews totaling about 100 people — many of them former river or fishing guides who lost their livelihoods after the hurricane.
occurrences.speaker: Jon Stamper
occurrences.subject: MountainTrue cleanup of IPEX PVC pipe in the French Broad River

occurrences.checkable_against: MountainTrue project accounting records
occurrences.quote_span: The organization said there’s still a long way to go and estimates it has spent 50,000 work-hours and over $1.5 million on pipe removal, which is only in the French Broad.
occurrences.speaker: MountainTrue
occurrences.subject: MountainTrue cleanup of IPEX PVC pipe in the French Broad River

occurrences.checkable_against: French Broad River cleanup surveys and ecological field observations
occurrences.quote_span: Removing the pipe is especially vexing because it binds with other debris and has become embedded in the river bottom, with fish and other creatures taking up residence inside.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: MountainTrue cleanup of IPEX PVC pipe in the French Broad River

occurrences.checkable_against: MountainTrue river debris site surveys
occurrences.quote_span: Some of the pipes — both straight, rigid plastic and flexible coils that have unraveled — are under huge piles of tangled logs topped by other debris, often in mounds 20 feet (6 meters) high.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: MountainTrue cleanup of IPEX PVC pipe in the French Broad River

occurrences.checkable_against: MountainTrue cleanup priority plans and hazard assessments
occurrences.quote_span: The first priority was removing pipes that could pose an immediate danger or entrapment hazard to tubers or kayakers, and much of the remaining debris stranded in flood plains and on banks, especially around riverbends and corners, and vulnerable to being washed away in another flood, Stamper said.
occurrences.speaker: Jon Stamper
occurrences.subject: MountainTrue cleanup of IPEX PVC pipe in the French Broad River

occurrences.checkable_against: MountainTrue grant applications and cleanup program plans
occurrences.quote_span: MountainTrue is applying for other grants to help extend its program after state and IPEX funding run out, Stamper said, because it could take years to remove all the debris.
occurrences.speaker: Jon Stamper
occurrences.subject: MountainTrue cleanup of IPEX PVC pipe in the French Broad River

occurrences.checkable_against: French Broad River observations at changing water levels
occurrences.quote_span: It becomes apparent many pipes are still in the river whenever water levels change, he said.
occurrences.speaker: Jon Stamper
occurrences.subject: MountainTrue cleanup of IPEX PVC pipe in the French Broad River

occurrences.checkable_against: MountainTrue labor and project accounting records
occurrences.quote_span: The organization said there’s still a long way to go and estimates it has spent 50,000 work-hours and over $1.5 million on pipe removal, which is only in the French Broad.
occurrences.speaker: MountainTrue
occurrences.subject: MountainTrue cleanup of IPEX PVC pipe in the French Broad River

occurrences.checkable_against: MountainTrue staffing and crew assignment records
occurrences.quote_span: Stamper, who formerly worked for a whitewater river outfitter and now oversees 10 cleanup crews totaling about 100 people — many of them former river or fishing guides who lost their livelihoods after the hurricane.
occurrences.speaker: Jon Stamper
occurrences.subject: MountainTrue cleanup of IPEX PVC pipe in the French Broad River

occurrences.checkable_against: IPEX-MountainTrue funding agreement and payment records
occurrences.quote_span: The company acknowledged that the remaining debris is significant and has agreed to pay MountainTrue $500,000 toward continued cleanup on the French Broad, allowing the organization to continue working into next year.
occurrences.speaker: IPEX
occurrences.subject: MountainTrue cleanup of IPEX PVC pipe in the French Broad River

occurrences.checkable_against: MountainTrue cleanup completion records and remaining debris surveys
occurrences.quote_span: “But there’s going to be pipe out there that we can’t get ever.”
occurrences.speaker: Jon Stamper
occurrences.subject: MountainTrue cleanup of IPEX PVC pipe in the French Broad River

occurrences.checkable_against: PVC degradation studies and French Broad River microplastic monitoring
occurrences.quote_span: Stamper said he also worries about long-term environmental and health effects from the pipe, which can degrade and become brittle, leaving microplastics in the river.
occurrences.speaker: Jon Stamper
occurrences.subject: MountainTrue cleanup of IPEX PVC pipe in the French Broad River
